newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran to host Mideast oil and gas conference in May.
newsitem.headline: Iran to host Mideast oil and gas conference in May.

text.p: Iran will host a Middle East oil and gas conference in Isfahan from May 8-10, organisers said on Monday.

The conference entitled "Middle East Oil and Gas: Towards the Third Millennium" will examine the future role of Middle East energy resources, the geopolitics of energy, international petroleum investments and oil markets.
OPEC Secretary General Rilwanu Lukman and Iranian Oil Minister Gholamreza Aghazadeh are expected to address the conference, which is being organised by the Iranian Petroleum Institute (IPI).
Registration details can be obtained from the National Iranian Oil Company (NIOC), telephone: +98 21 6152599, 6468005, 6152503.
